correctness.rationale: For separable monic quintic F over an algebraically closed field of characteristic seven, y^3=F has genus 4 and basis dx/y, x^i dx/y^2 for i=0,1,2. Since 7=1 mod3, Cartier matrix splits scalar h=[x^6]F^2=c3^2+2*c4*c2+2*c1 and a 3x3 F^4 coefficient block. Independently recomputed exact GF(7)[c0,..,c4] 3x3 determinant (107 monomials) = h times quintic discriminant (55 monomials). Hence det H=h^2*Delta universally, not merely at F7 points. On Delta nonzero the hypersurface h=0 is an affine 4-space (linear in c1), with Cartier rank at most 2, a>=2, p-rank<=2; complement ordinary. F=x^5+1 gives smooth nonordinary point. No stronger a-number or complete EO claim.
